source: ライデン (重装ガンシップ) の船内改修用 54 枚 (シート 94〜99、画像はまだ無い)。名前はすべて rd-。設計図は docs/raiden-interior.md。乗員区画
style: Interior of a heavy gunship spacecraft in a grounded, worn military style: dark gunmetal, red accent lights, scuffs and stencils. PICTURE cells: ONE item or wall section seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text, letters, numbers or logos. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.

cells.name: rd-crew-wall
cells.prompt: Crew quarters wall: beige padded panels with red piping and small vents, front-on.

cells.name: rd-bunk-blanket
cells.prompt: A dark red military wool blanket with a grey stripe, close-up.

cells.name: rd-crew-locker
cells.prompt: A tall personal crew locker, half open, with a jacket, photos taped inside and a towel, front-on.

cells.name: rd-galley
cells.prompt: A compact ship galley wall: steel cabinets, a hot drink dispenser and hanging mugs, front-on.

cells.name: rd-mess-table
cells.prompt: A crew mess table seen from directly above: steel tabletop with metal trays, cups and a deck of cards.

cells.name: rd-medbay-wall

cells.name: rd-med-scanner
